init.title: Enable experimental machine controls
init.description: Controls operate real heaters and the pump. Enable only for an attended commissioning session. Setup never fires a control. Profile start uses the already selected mode-2 profile, not necessarily the paddle-bound profile. Prepare the machine and cup before starting. No remote emergency stop, setpoint writes, profile uploads or schedules are provided.

data.allow_boiler_control: Enable independent brew and steam boiler switches
data.allow_profile_start: Enable start of the currently selected stored profile

user.title: Choose a WENDOUGEE DATA S machine
user.description: Select a machine already discovered by Home Assistant Bluetooth.

confirm.title: Enable experimental read-only telemetry?
confirm.description: Confirmation starts periodic read-only Bluetooth telemetry, operating-state and configuration requests. No brewing, heating or cleaning controls are included. Disconnect E-Bar and other clients first. Values and polling behavior still need physical validation; do not use these sensors as safety interlocks. Reads temporarily occupy the machine's Bluetooth connection.

data.confirm: I approve read-only polling of this machine

abort.not_supported: This is not a connectable WDG_Data device.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured DATA machines are visible through Home Assistant Bluetooth. Check that the machine is advertising and other clients are disconnected.
abort.multiple_devices_found: More than one connectable DATA machine is visible; use the UI to select one explicitly.
